name: zframe
title: Z axis frame
orientation: Flat on the bed: the rods' holes run along the bed and have teardrop roofs, the motor's mount cut through the top bar
description: Bolts into the forearm's yoke where the pen holder or gripper bolts. Two bars hold two 8 mm rods; a 28BYJ-48 on the top bar turns a T8 screw between them.

width.rule: The bars' thickness: the motor's screws sit 8 mm off the shaft, so the plate has to reach past them

block_w.rule: The block's thickness, the yoke's slot

half.rule: Half of it: the rods and the screw lie here

block_x.rule: Half the block in the yoke

bar_x.rule: The bars' far edge: past the second rod's hole

y_in.rule: Half the window between the bars: the carriage and its 50 mm of travel

y_out.rule: Outside the bars: 10 mm of bar, enough for the motor's screws

sx.rule: From the bolts to the screw

rod_gap.rule: Each rod from the screw: wide enough to clear the nut's flange and take the load's tipping

rod.rule: The 8 mm rod's hole: a light press, printed
rod.label: Rod

screw.rule: The lead screw through the bottom bar, loose: its end only steadied

offset.rule: The 28BYJ-48's screws sit this far from its shaft

motor_hole.rule: The motor's tab screws, an M3 or a 4 mm

boss.rule: Round the motor's boss, through the top bar
